name: Fruit Bread
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), WATER, GLAZED FRUITS (13.9%) [PAPAYA CUTS, SUGAR, ACIDITY REGULATOR (330), PINEAPPLE CUTS, PRESERVATIVE (202), COLOURS (124, 110 & 102), ARTIFICIAL (MIXED BERRY) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE], SUGAR, YEAST, REFINED SOYABEAN OIL, IODIZED SALT, PRESERVATIVES (282 & 200), STABILIZER (412), ACIDITY REGULATOR (260), EMULSIFIERS (471 & 481 (i)), FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT (510) AND ANTIOXIDANT (300).
